# Real archive fixture

`wise-d6.fits` is a trimmed real IRSA cutout retrieved on 13 November 2026 at RA 133.795129°, Dec −7.245147°, size 5 arcminutes. It retains the original primary header and IMAGE, FLAGS, VARIANCE, WCS-WAVE HDUs. The unused EPSF/ZODI HDUs were removed solely to keep this test fixture small. Pixel values are unchanged.

Source: https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/ibe/data/spherex/dr1/level2/2025W19_1B/l2b-v27-2026-197/6/level2_2025W19_1B_0116_1D6_spx_l2b-v27-2026-197.fits?center=133.795129,-7.245147d&size=0.08333333333333333

Uses SPHEREx data products, a joint JPL/Caltech project funded by NASA, distributed by Caltech/IPAC IRSA. This fixture supports reproducible decoding and mask tests; it is not evidence for a detection of WISE 0855.
